did: ENGAGE in the Nov 13 coordinator run. Three pull requests, each green and handed to the coordinator to merge. First, the weekly engagement report's writer (#2910): code writes each week's report from home's counts with no AI, comparing this week with last week, a quarter ago and a year ago, and your rule is code with its own test. Counts under 5 read 'fewer than 5', no times of day or stop answers, aph and Jobs as one line, and a week with no record reads 'no data', never zero. Weeks run Monday to Monday on your Pacific clock, and home's new week read (server #819) agreed to the same. Second, aph now says which of its views, missed days and their figures were offered and which you took (#2912). Third, LeetType's phone sessions now speak the same words, read from the session log it already keeps rather than a second record (#2913). An independent review found real bugs in each before merge, all fixed: a save counted as opening History, the log offered on the wrong side of the form, and a reading counted as taken only when its source was opened.

calls.title: When a weekly change shows its number
options: the difference only where both weeks are 5 or more
the difference always, beside a banded count
no difference at all, only up, down or flat
calls.why: A difference beside a 'fewer than 5' would give the banded count away (C143).

calls.title: Each count banded on its own
options: band each count on its own, as your rule reads
band offered and taken too whenever passed over is under 5
leave passed over out of the report
calls.why: Offered minus taken roughly gives passed over away, but hiding it would hide counts your own example shows, like 'Drama: offered 12, taken 0' (C144).
calls.undo: In publicLines, band offered and taken for a week whose passed over is under 5.

calls.title: When aph's log counts as taken
options: when a figure of mine is saved
when the form is first touched
calls.why: aph opens on the Log view, so counting the opening would make every visit a take (C145).
calls.undo: Move the take in AphLog from the save to where the form is first changed.
